description: Karnataka has cleared ₹2.16 crore for an AI‑based facial recognition system to track student attendance, integrating with SATS and KAAMS from 2026–27. Karnataka, Top News
body_lead: Karnataka has cleared ₹2.16 crore for an AI‑based facial recognition system to track student attendance, integrating with SATS and KAAMS from 2026–27 The Karnataka government has formally approved the deployment of an AI‑driven facial recognition attendance system across schools and colleges, marking a significant step in its e‑Governance initiatives. The order, signed on 16 February 2026, outlines both the budget and technical framework for the project, which will be integrated into the state’s Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS).
